headlines.title: State Street Health Care SPDR (XLV) Sells Eli Lilly and J&J on Friday
headlines.summary: The fund sold $283.4 million of stock, cutting all 60 positions and adding nothing, led by a $47.7 million reduction in Eli Lilly.

headlines.title: Biotech Loses Ground In November’s Market Slide — These 5 Stocks Bucked The Selloff As Lilly, AbbVie And Amgen Fell
headlines.summary: BBIO gained 6% through Monday. Shares were already up about 4% that day when trading halted ahead of FDA approval for Welgemda, the first U.S. treatment for limb-girdle muscular dystrophy.

headlines.title: Lilly highlights strength of breast cancer portfolio with new data across validated drivers of hormone receptor-positive disease at the 2026 San Antonio Breast Cancer Symposium
headlines.summary: Eli Lilly and Company (NYSE: LLY) today announced that new data from across its breast cancer portfolio, spanning early to advanced hormone receptor-positive (HR+) breast cancer, will be featured at the San Antonio Breast Cancer Symposium (SABCS), taking place December 8–11 in San Antonio, Texas. Lilly's presence marks the progress in a portfolio built around the biology of HR+ breast cancer, targeting three clinically validated drivers of the disease: the estrogen receptor, CDK4/6 and PI3Kα.

headlines.title: Lilly executive calls oncology the key growth area after obesity
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Eli Lilly & Co. identified cancer treatment as its next major growth opportunity following its success in the obesity market, according to Jake Van Naarden, the company's head of business development and oncology.

headlines.title: Ahmed family office pays $18M for Summit’s Fulton Market HQ
headlines.summary: Summit Design + Build president Adam Miller (seller) and Goldfinch founder and CEO Omair Ahmed (buyer) with 1036-1042 W. Fulton Market (Getty, Goldfinch, Summit Design + Build, Google Maps)A Chicago family office paid $18 million for the Fulton Market building developed by Summit Design + Build, an owner-user deal that priced well above recent neighborhood office trades.

description: Eli Lilly and Company discovers, develops, manufactures, and markets human pharmaceutical products in the United States, Europe, China, Japan, and internationally. The company offers cardiometabolic health products, including Basaglar, Humalog, Humalog Mix 75/25, Humalog U-100, Humalog U-200, Humalog Mix 50/50, insulin lispro, insulin lispro protamine, insulin lispro mix 75/25, Humulin, Humulin 70/30, Humulin N, Humulin R, Humulin U-500 for diabetes; Jardiance, Mounjaro, and Trulicity for type 2 diabetes; and Zepbound for obesity. It also provides oncology products, such as Cyramza for the second-line treatment of gastric cancer or gastro-esophageal junction adenocarcinoma; Erbitux for colorectal cancers and head and neck cancers; Inluriyo for breast cancer; Jaypirca for chronic lymphocytic leukemia or small lymphocytic lymphoma; Retevmo for the treatment of metastatic NSCLC; TYVYT for classic hodgkin's lymphoma; and Verzenio for breast cancer. In addition, the company offers immunology products, which include Ebglyss; Olumiant; Omvoh; and Taltz. Further, it provides Emgality for migraine prevention and episodic cluster headache; and Kisubla for symptomatic Alzheimer's disease. The company has collaborations with Boehringer Ingelheim Pharmaceuticals, Inc. for the Jardiance product family; and F. Hoffmann-La Roche Ltd and Genentech, Inc. for lebrikizumab, as well as license agreements with Almirall, S.A. for Ebglyss; and Chugai Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd for orforglipron; strategic collaboration with Ascidian Therapeutics for development of therapies for undisclosed monogenic kidney diseases; BioArctic AB (publ) for new treatment; QurCan Therapeutics Inc for development of PLNP-enabled genetic medicine therapeutics for the treatment of central nervous system and peripheral nervous system; and Abbisko Therapeutics for discovery and development of medicines across multiple targets. The company was founded in 1876 and is headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana.
